## The 8 best Partnero alternatives

### 1. Rekomi

Rekomi is an all-in-one affiliate platform for brands and SaaS that builds done-for-you payouts and tax handling into the base price, so you are not stitching together extra tools or paying a premium to pay affiliates.

Best for: Teams that want a low monthly base with payouts and tax fully included, and who only want to pay more when affiliates actually earn.

Key features:

 Built-in payouts through Stripe Express and PayPal, plus tax forms (W-9, W-8BEN, W-8BEN-E, and 1099) included in every plan.
 First-party tracking on your own custom domain, which holds up better against ad blockers and privacy changes.
 One-click CSV migration from six platforms, an AI co-pilot to help you launch, and recurring commissions out of the box. [...] > TL;DR: Best Partnero alternatives at a glance
>
> 1. Rekomi Lowest entry price with payouts and tax forms built in; you pay 3% only when affiliates actually earn.
> 2. Rewardful The fastest no-code setup for Stripe and Paddle SaaS businesses.
> 3. FirstPromoter The deepest subscription analytics for SaaS teams that live in MRR and churn.

## What is Partnero?

Partnero is an affiliate and referral platform that lets brands run several kinds of programs from one dashboard. Beyond classic affiliate programs, it supports referral programs and even newsletter referral campaigns, which makes it unusual in a market where most tools do one thing. [...] Is there a free Partnero alternative?

Yes. Trackdesk has a free plan that stays free until you reach about $5,000/mo in affiliate revenue, with unlimited clicks, conversions, and affiliates. Its tax handling sits on a higher plan, so the free tier is best for getting started rather than running a large, payout-heavy program.

Does Partnero pay affiliates and handle tax for you?

Yes, Partnero has built-in payouts and tax handling. The thing to watch is the cost of the managed-payout option, which adds 7% on top of your plan. If you would rather not pay a high percentage, LeadDyno and FirstPromoter include managed payouts with no separate cut, and Tolt automates payouts and tax for a 2% fee from its Growth plan.

### Try Partnero: The Best Post Affiliate Pro Alternative

While there are many Post Affiliate Pro alternatives in 2026, Partnero stands out for its mix of functionality, ease of use, and pricing suitable for businesses of all sizes. Whether you want to grow your affiliate programs, streamline referral marketing, or manage complex partner ecosystems, Partnero is the clear #1 choice in 2026. As highlighted in reviews on sites like Influencer Marketing Hub, Partnero is built for growth. With a unified platform for all partnership types, predictable pricing with no revenue caps, superior automation, and a fully brandable experience, Partnero provides the foundation you need to build a world-class program. [...] Use free trials and demos to ensure you find the right fit for your business. On that note, why not sign up for Partnero’s 30-day free trial? No credit card required.

### FAQs

What is the best Post Affiliate Pro alternative for SaaS?

Partnero is built specifically for SaaS and ecommerce, with deep Stripe integration for tracking subscriptions, renewals, and upgrades. FirstPromoter and Rewardful are also strong fits for SaaS teams on tighter budgets.

What's the difference between Post Affiliate Pro and Partnero?

Partnero combines affiliate tracking, referral programs, and AI powered partner discovery in one platform with flat, transparent pricing and no revenue caps. Post Affiliate Pro is a longer standing tool with a more dated interface and a steeper learning curve. [...] Which alternative works best with Shopify or Stripe?

Partnero and Rewardful both offer native Stripe integration. For Shopify specific stores, Partnero has a Shopify app and offers product based commission structure that lets you reward affiliates differently by plan or product.

Which Post Affiliate Pro alternative has the easiest setup?

Partnero, Rewardful, and FirstPromoter all offer quick setup with guided onboarding. Partnero additionally offers migration assistance for teams importing data from another platform.

Do these alternatives offer a free trial?

Most do. Partnero, LeadDyno, Tapfiliate, and Rewardful all offer free trials ranging from 14 to 30 days, several with no credit card required.
